title: Export the order list as a spreadsheet
description:
Shop owners want the order list in a spreadsheet.

## Spec

The export is described here; the criteria are below.

- **FR-001**: The order list can be exported as CSV.
- FR-002 Each export names its date range.
- AC-1: The first row holds the column names (FR-001)
- [ ] 1. Write the exporter
- [x] 1.1 Add the export button
- [ ] Document the export

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An export of 10,000 orders finishes in under 2 seconds.
- [ ] An empty date range gives a file
  with the header row only
- AC-3 A failed export says why (FR-002)

## Requirements

1. Exports stream rows rather than building the file in memory
2. NFR-1 Memory stays flat as the order count grows

## Notes

- This list is not a requirement.
